mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (product_id, current_stock, frozen_stock) VALUES (#{productId}, #{currentStock}, #{frozenStock})
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET current_stock = current_stock + #{quantity} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
UPDATE inventory SET current_stock = current_stock - #{quantity} WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND current_stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE inventory SET current_stock = #{actualStock} WHERE product_id = #{productId}

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, c.name AS category_name, u.name AS unit_name, IFNULL(i.current_stock, 0) AS current_stock, p.purchase_price, (IFNULL(i.current_stock, 0) * p.purchase_price) AS stock_value, p.safety_stock, CASE WHEN p.safety_stock > 0 AND IFNULL(i.current_stock, 0) < p.safety_stock THEN true ELSE false END AS is_warning FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit u ON p.unit_id = u.id LEFT JOIN inventory i ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.category_id, p.id
